name: Sumeragi Yamato
source:
In ~Yamana Gakuen Hen, Yamato Hen~
A third year student at Yamana Academy. He's acquaintances with Saijou Hikaru since their childhood. The son of a family that owns a major hospital, he's meant to succeed the family business. However, due to disagreements between him and his parents, Yamato has been constantly getting into delinquent conduct. Despite his misconduct, his grades are excellent as his brilliant mind allows him to remember whatever he's observed at least once. Yamato was once apathetic towards anyone but since the protagonist saved him when he got into a fight in a back alley three years ago, she's the only person he's become attached to.
